newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT -JGBs seen stuck in recent ranges.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -JGBs seen stuck in recent ranges.

text.p: JGBs are likely to stay stuck in recent trading ranges on Tuesday in the absence of decisive factors in a market that has been led by demand/supply balance since the start of this week, traders said.

At 0130 GMT, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) is expected to offer 400 billion yen of six-year notes with a coupon of 1.9 percent. MOF consulted underwriters on Monday about its plan to reduce the issue amount to 400 billion from 500 billion due to recent rises in tax revenue.
The market generally expects good results for the offer due to healthy investor demand.
"If the MOF's move to slash bond issue volume spreads to the benchmark 10-year issues, that would positively affect the market," said a senior trader at a city bank's securities arm.
The market will be watching for developments in Japan's financial market scandal.

Japan's Jiji news service on Monday quoted a lawyer for Ryuichi Koike, a key figure in a high-profile payoff scandal involving Dai-Ichi Kangyo Bank Ltd and Nomura Securities Co Ltd as saying that Nikko Securities and Daiwa Securities had also conducted illegal deals for him.
